description: This file contains GLSL shader functions related to tensor indexing and coordinate transformations, specifically for 4D tensors in a Vulkan environment.

methods.name: uvec4 idx_to_coord(const uint idx,const uvec4 strides,const uvec4 sizes)
methods.description: Converts a linear index to a 4D tensor coordinate based on strides and sizes.

methods.name: uint coord_to_idx(const uvec4 coord,const uvec4 strides)
methods.description: Computes a linear index from a 4D tensor coordinate using strides.

methods.name: int align_up_4(int v)
methods.description: Aligns an integer value up to the nearest multiple of 4.

methods.name: ivec4 get_channel_packed_pos_from_index(ivec4 nchw,ivec4 sizes)
methods.description: Calculates the (x, y, z, index) position within a channel-packed 3D tensor from a given {n, c, h, w}-index.

ctags.name: coord_to_idx
ctags.pattern: /^uint coord_to_idx(const uvec4 coord, const uvec4 strides) {$/

ctags.name: idx_to_coord
ctags.pattern: /^uvec4 idx_to_coord(const uint idx, const uvec4 strides, const uvec4 sizes) {$/
ctags.signature: (const uint idx,const uvec4 strides,const uvec4 sizes)
